sentences.en: In a major speech at Mount Rushmore, President Trump said that the goal of nationwide protests is not, quote, a better America.
sentences.zh: 在拉什莫尔山发表的一次重要演讲中，特朗普总统表示，全国性抗议活动的目标并非“一个更好的美国”。

sentences.en: Their goal, he said, is the end of America.
sentences.zh: 他说，他们的目标是终结美国。

sentences.en: Maggie Haberman on what that speech reveals about the president's re-election campaign.
sentences.zh: 玛吉·哈伯曼将解读这次演讲揭示了总统竞选连任的哪些意图。

sentences.en: Tuesday, July 7th.
sentences.zh: 7月7日，星期二。

sentences.en: Maggie, heading into this July 4th weekend, what was our understanding of what this Mount Rushmore speech from President Trump, what it was for, what it was intended to do?
sentences.zh: 玛吉，在进入7月4日这个周末之际，我们对特朗普总统这次拉什莫尔山演讲的理解是什么？它的目的是什么？它旨在实现什么？

sentences.en: So, Michael, the month of June was pretty calamitous for President Trump politically and in terms of his legacy.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，六月份对特朗普总统来说，无论是在政治上还是在他的政治遗产方面，都是相当灾难性的一个月。

sentences.en: It began with the federal government having protesters forcibly cleared using chemical
sentences.zh: 这一切始于联邦政府动用化学

sentences.en: irritants from Lafayette Park across from the White House so that the president could then take a
sentences.zh: 刺激剂强行驱散了白宫对面拉斐特公园的抗议者，以便总统随后可以进行

sentences.en: photo op to mass protests across the country to a huge spike in coronavirus cases in areas of the
sentences.zh: 一场作秀式的拍照活动，接着是全国范围内的大规模抗议，以及在全国

sentences.en: country where it really had not been that prevalent and where the governors in those states were looking toward reopening.
sentences.zh: 疫情本不严重且州长们正考虑重启经济的地区，新冠病例出现了激增。

sentences.en: So the president tried for a reboot of his campaign with a rally in Tulsa on
sentences.zh: 因此，总统试图在6月20日于塔尔萨举行集会，

sentences.en: June 20th.
sentences.zh: 为他的竞选活动重启造势。

sentences.en: That rally was sparsely attended compared to what they had advertised as their likely attendance.
sentences.zh: 与他们宣传的预期出席人数相比，那次集会的到场人数寥寥无几。

sentences.en: And so Mount Rushmore and this event was supposed to be the reboot of the failed reboot.
sentences.zh: 所以，拉什莫尔山的这次活动被寄予厚望，旨在重启那次失败的重启。

sentences.en: This was going to be an effort by the president to show he was in charge and trying to look toward the general election.
sentences.zh: 这是总统试图展示他掌控全局并着眼于大选的一次努力。

sentences.en: And from your reporting, what was this reboot of the reboot going to look like in the speech?
sentences.zh: 根据你的报道，这次“重启的重启”在演讲中会是什么样子？

sentences.en: So the president needs an enemy to fight againSt. In 2018, during the midterms, you saw the president
sentences.zh: 总统需要一个敌人来再次对抗。在2018年的中期选举期间，你看到总统

sentences.en: going to try to galvanize support against a looming threat, as he put it, of a caravan that was headed across the southern border with Mexico.
sentences.zh: 试图通过制造一个迫在眉睫的威胁来激发支持，正如他所言，那是一个正穿过墨西哥南部边境向美国挺进的移民大篷车队。

sentences.en: And this was basically a threat of a foreign invasion.
sentences.zh: 这基本上被描述为一种外国入侵的威胁。

sentences.en: And he talked about this a lot and he tweeted about it a lot.
sentences.zh: 他多次谈论此事，并在推特上频繁提及。

sentences.en: And the main enemy that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而美国目前面临的主要敌人

sentences.en: is dealing with right now is the coronavirus, which is spreading rapidly.
sentences.zh: 是正在迅速蔓延的新冠病毒。

sentences.en: That's an issue on which his polling is pretty bad and his advisors know it.
sentences.zh: 这是他民调表现相当糟糕的一个议题，他的顾问们对此心知肚明。

sentences.en: And another force that the country is dealing with right now is police brutality.
sentences.zh: 而国家目前面临的另一股力量是警察暴力。

sentences.en: Neither of those are issues that Donald Trump is seen as particularly strong on or areas where he has shown he wants to lead.
sentences.zh: 这两者都不是唐纳德·特朗普被认为表现强劲的领域，也不是他展现出领导意愿的议题。

sentences.en: So instead, looking for this enemy, AIDS described in his speech he was going to go after a left-wing culture coming after people who don't agree with it.
sentences.zh: 因此，为了寻找这个敌人，他在演讲中描述称，他将矛头指向一个左翼文化，去攻击那些不同意它的人。

sentences.en: Now the threat is other Americans.
sentences.zh: 现在，威胁变成了其他美国人。

sentences.en: The threat is people who don't think like you.
sentences.zh: 威胁是那些想法与你不同的人。

sentences.en: Well, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢。

sentences.en: And Governor Noem and Secretary
sentences.zh: 诺姆州长和伯恩哈特部长，

sentences.en: Bernhardt, we very much appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们非常感谢你们。

sentences.en: Members of Congress, distinguished guests, and a very special hello to
sentences.zh: 国会议员们、尊贵的嘉宾们，还要特别向

sentences.en: South Dakota.
sentences.zh: 南达科他州问好。

sentences.en: Okay, let's talk about how this speech actually unfolds.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们来谈谈这次演讲实际上是如何展开的。

sentences.en: I watched it.
sentences.zh: 我看了。

sentences.en: I know you did as well.
sentences.zh: 我知道你也看了。

sentences.en: So I want us to walk through it and pick out a few key passages that illuminate what he's actually up to here.
sentences.zh: 所以我想让我们梳理一下，挑选出几个关键段落，看看他到底想表达什么。

sentences.en: Kind of a close reading of this speech.
sentences.zh: 对这次演讲进行一次细读。

sentences.en: So where do you think we should start?
sentences.zh: 那么你认为我们应该从哪里开始？

sentences.en: I would start just understanding what it looked like.
sentences.zh: 我会从了解现场景象开始。

sentences.en: He was standing at this podium, surrounded by flags in front of this historic monument.
sentences.zh: 他站在讲台上，周围环绕着旗帜，背景是这座历史悠久的纪念碑。

sentences.en: There could be no better place to celebrate America's independence than beneath this
sentences.zh: 没有什么地方比在这座

sentences.en: magnificent, incredible, majestic mountain monument to the greatest Americans who have ever lived.
sentences.zh: 宏伟、不可思议、壮丽的山岳纪念碑下，纪念有史以来最伟大的美国人，更适合庆祝美国的独立了。

sentences.en: And that was supposed to underscore this current conversation about monuments and statues around the country.
sentences.zh: 这旨在强调当前关于全国各地纪念碑和雕像的讨论。

sentences.en: I am here as your president to proclaim before the country and before the world, this monument will never be desecrated.
sentences.zh: 我作为你们的总统，在此向全国和全世界宣告，这座纪念碑永远不会被亵渎。

sentences.en: These heroes will never be defaced.
sentences.zh: 这些英雄永远不会被诋毁。

sentences.en: Their legacy will never, ever be destroyed.
sentences.zh: 他们的遗产永远、永远不会被摧毁。

sentences.en: Their achievements will never be forgotten.
sentences.zh: 他们的成就永远不会被遗忘。

sentences.en: And Mount Rushmore will stand forever as an eternal tribute to our forefathers and to our freedom.
sentences.zh: 拉什莫尔山将永远作为我们先辈和我们自由的永恒丰碑屹立不倒。

sentences.en: Much of the conversation has been around Confederate totems, Confederate statues, the Confederate flag.
sentences.zh: 大部分讨论都围绕着邦联图腾、邦联雕像和邦联旗帜展开。

sentences.en: The president has resisted those conversations, but even members of his own party have said that it is time to remove some of those monuments.
sentences.zh: 总统抵制了这些讨论，但即使是他自己党内的成员也表示，是时候移除其中一些纪念碑了。

sentences.en: Where he is drawing the line is when the conversation moves to
sentences.zh: 他划定的底线是，当讨论涉及

sentences.en: George Washington or Thomas Jefferson.
sentences.zh: 乔治·华盛顿或托马斯·杰斐逊时。

sentences.en: Those are two of the faces on Mount Rushmore.
sentences.zh: 他们是拉什莫尔山上的两张面孔。

sentences.en: And that's part of why he's choosing to have this conversation there.
sentences.zh: 这就是他选择在那里进行这次对话的部分原因。

sentences.en: And what is he saying about that debate around statues to presidents like that?
sentences.zh: 那么对于围绕这些总统雕像的辩论，他说了些什么？

sentences.en: What he is suggesting is that the political left is trying to rewrite history.
sentences.zh: 他暗示政治左派正试图改写历史。

sentences.en: 1776 represented the culmination of thousands of years of Western civilization and the triumph of not only spirit, but of wisdom, philosophy, and reason.
sentences.zh: 1776年代表了数千年西方文明的结晶，不仅是精神的胜利，更是智慧、哲学和理性的胜利。

sentences.en: And yet...
sentences.zh: 然而……

sentences.en: By calling into question those men, by suggesting that their legacies need to be thought about again.
sentences.zh: 通过质疑这些人，通过暗示他们的遗产需要被重新审视。

sentences.en: As we meet here tonight, there is a growing danger that threatens every blessing our ancestors fought so hard for, struggled.
sentences.zh: 当我们今晚在此相聚时，一种日益增长的危险正威胁着我们祖先为之奋斗、挣扎所争取到的每一项福祉。

sentences.en: They bled to secure our nation.
sentences.zh: 他们流血牺牲才保卫了我们的国家。

sentences.en: Now, the reason that people are saying that their legacies need to be reconsidered is because they were slaveholders.
sentences.zh: 现在，人们说他们的遗产需要被重新审视的原因是他们曾是奴隶主。

sentences.en: And that you can't have an honest conversation about race if you do not acknowledge that.
sentences.zh: 如果你不承认这一点，就无法就种族问题进行诚实的对话。

sentences.en: Our nation is witnessing a merciless campaign to wipe out our history,
sentences.zh: 我们的国家正在目睹一场无情的运动，旨在抹杀我们的历史，

sentences.en: defame our heroes, erase our values, and indoctrinate our children.
sentences.zh: 诋毁我们的英雄，抹去我们的价值观，并向我们的孩子灌输思想。

sentences.en: What he's really trying to do is convince Republicans who are feeling shaky about him, and he hopes, some independent voters,
sentences.zh: 他真正试图做的是说服那些对他感到动摇的共和党人，并希望说服一些独立选民，

sentences.en: that the protests around the country have gone too far.
sentences.zh: 全国各地的抗议活动已经走得太远了。

sentences.en: He is trying to get them to see it the way he sees it, which is, this isn't just a movement about the Confederacy.
sentences.zh: 他试图让他们以他的视角来看待问题，即：这不仅仅是一场关于邦联的运动。

sentences.en: They're coming for our whole history, our.
sentences.zh: 他们冲着我们整个历史来了，我们的。

sentences.en: They are coming for the history of white America.
sentences.zh: 他们冲着白人美国的历史来了。

sentences.en: Angry mobs are trying to tear down statues of our founders to face our most sacred memorials and unleash a wave of violent crime in our cities.
sentences.zh: 愤怒的暴徒正试图推倒我们开国元勋的雕像，诋毁我们最神圣的纪念碑，并在我们的城市中引发一波暴力犯罪浪潮。

sentences.en: It is in keeping with what President Trump has done for many, many years now, which is an us-versus-them approach to his base of older white voters.
sentences.zh: 这与特朗普总统多年来所做的一贯做法相符，即对他那部分年长的白人选民基础采取“我们对他们”的对立策略。

sentences.en: But no, the American people are strong and proud, and they will not allow our country and all of its values, history, and culture to be taken from them.
sentences.zh: 但绝不，美国人民是强大而自豪的，他们不会允许我们的国家及其所有的价值观、历史和文化被夺走。

sentences.en: Okay, what stands out next to you in this speech?
sentences.zh: 好的，在这次演讲中，接下来有什么让你印象深刻的地方？

sentences.en: So the president very quickly went on to talk about how a, quote-unquote, political weapon of the Americans he's talking about in this speech is...
sentences.zh: 总统很快就开始谈论他演讲中所提到的美国人所使用的所谓“政治武器”是……

sentences.en: Cancel culture.
sentences.zh: 取消文化。

sentences.en: ...so-called cancel culture.
sentences.zh: ……所谓的取消文化。

sentences.en: Driving people from their jobs,
sentences.zh: 将人们赶出工作岗位，

sentences.en: shaming dissenters, and demanding total submission from anyone who disagrees.
sentences.zh: 羞辱持不同政见者，并要求任何持不同意见的人完全屈服。

sentences.en: He is describing it as anyone who disagrees with certain folks are going to get chased out of polite society.
sentences.zh: 他将其描述为：任何与某些人意见不合的人都将被赶出文明社会。

sentences.en: And that's not really what this is.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是事情的真相。

sentences.en: This is the very definition of totalitarianism.
sentences.zh: 这正是极权主义的定义。

sentences.en: And it is completely alien to our culture and to our values.
sentences.zh: 它与我们的文化和价值观完全格格不入。

sentences.en: And it has absolutely no place in the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 它在美利坚合众国绝对没有立足之地。

sentences.en: So in part, this is appealing to a long-standing sense among conservatives that they are being attacked by the left for their beliefs.
sentences.zh: 因此，在某种程度上，这迎合了保守派长期以来的一种感觉，即他们因自己的信仰而受到左派的攻击。

sentences.en: Also notice his emphasis on our values and our culture.
sentences.zh: 还要注意他强调“我们的价值观”和“我们的文化”。

sentences.en: He has used the words culture and values repeatedly to appeal to his base since 2017.
sentences.zh: 自2017年以来，他反复使用“文化”和“价值观”这两个词来吸引他的选民基础。

sentences.en: This is the thing that he shares with his voters.
sentences.zh: 这是他与选民共享的东西。

sentences.en: It certainly is not geography in many places.
sentences.zh: 在很多地方，这肯定不是地理因素。

sentences.en: They're in the Deep South.
sentences.zh: 他们身处美国南部腹地。

sentences.en: And he is a man from Queens.
sentences.zh: 而他是一个来自皇后区的人。

sentences.en: But this sense of our way of life is being taken over is what he has used time and again to appeal to people.
sentences.zh: 但这种“我们的生活方式正在被接管”的感觉，是他一次又一次用来吸引人们的手段。

sentences.en: This attack on our liberty,
sentences.zh: 这种对我们自由的攻击，

sentences.en: our magnificent liberty, must be stopped.
sentences.zh: 我们宏伟的自由，必须被制止。

sentences.en: And it will be stopped very quickly.
sentences.zh: 而且它很快就会被制止。

sentences.en: We will expose this dangerous movement,
sentences.zh: 我们将揭露这场危险的运动，

sentences.en: protect our nation's children, end this radical assault, and preserve our beloved American way of life.
sentences.zh: 保护我们国家的孩子，终结这场激进的攻击，并维护我们钟爱的美国生活方式。

sentences.en: In our schools, our newsrooms, even our corporate boardrooms, there is a new far-left fascism that demands absolute allegiance.
sentences.zh: 在我们的学校、新闻编辑室，甚至企业董事会里，出现了一种新的极左法西斯主义，要求绝对的效忠。

sentences.en: If you do not speak its language, perform its rituals,
sentences.zh: 如果你不讲它的语言，不执行它的仪式，

sentences.en: recite its mantras, and follow its commandments, then you will be censored, banished,
sentences.zh: 不背诵它的口号，不遵守它的戒律，那么你就会被审查、被放逐、

sentences.en: blacklisted, persecuted,
sentences.zh: 被列入黑名单、被迫害，

sentences.en: and punished.
sentences.zh: 并受到惩罚。

sentences.en: It's not going to happen to us.
sentences.zh: 这不会发生在我们身上。

sentences.en: So, Maggie, what is the next passage in this speech that strikes you?
sentences.zh: 那么，玛吉，这次演讲中还有哪一段让你印象深刻？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So, keeping up with these themes, the president went on and said,
sentences.zh: 所以，延续这些主题，总统接着说，

sentences.en: This left-wing cultural revolution is designed to overthrow the American Revolution.
sentences.zh: 这场左翼文化革命旨在推翻美国革命。

sentences.en: This left-wing cultural revolution is designed to overthrow the American Revolution.
sentences.zh: 这场左翼文化革命旨在推翻美国革命。

sentences.en: And then he went on a little bit later to say,
sentences.zh: 然后他在稍后又说，

sentences.en: Their goal is not a better America.
sentences.zh: 他们的目标不是一个更好的美国。

sentences.en: Their goal is the end of America.
sentences.zh: 他们的目标是终结美国。

sentences.en: In so doing, they would destroy the very civilization that rescued billions from poverty, disease, violence, and hunger, and that lifted humanity to new heights of achievement,
sentences.zh: 在这样做的时候，他们将摧毁那个使数十亿人摆脱贫困、疾病、暴力和饥饿，并将人类提升到成就、

sentences.en: discovery, and progress.
sentences.zh: 发现和进步新高度的文明本身。

sentences.en: You would think that he was talking about the British the way that he's describing this.
sentences.zh: 听他描述的方式，你会以为他在谈论英国人。

sentences.en: In its place, they want power for themselves.
sentences.zh: 取而代之的是，他们想要为自己攫取权力。

sentences.en: As opposed to talking about
sentences.zh: 而不是谈论

sentences.en: primarily black people in this country, but not only, who have been trying to right historic wrongs.
sentences.zh: 这个国家主要是黑人，但不仅限于黑人，他们一直试图纠正历史错误。

sentences.en: He is making it sound, once again, as if something is being taken from him and his supporters.
sentences.zh: 他再次让事情听起来好像他和他的支持者正在失去什么东西。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: In this case,
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，

sentences.en: American civilization.
sentences.zh: 是美国文明。

sentences.en: Yes, and he is trying to drive that home with everything he says.
sentences.zh: 是的，他正试图通过他所说的一切来强化这一点。

sentences.en: I mean, this feels
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这感觉

sentences.en: like race-baiting.
sentences.zh: 就像种族挑衅。

sentences.en: I think it more than feels that way,
sentences.zh: 我认为这不仅仅是感觉，

sentences.en: Michael.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔。

sentences.en: I would argue it is race-baiting.
sentences.zh: 我会说这就是种族挑衅。

sentences.en: Look, I don't think that Donald Trump is suddenly a different person.
sentences.zh: 看，我不认为唐纳德·特朗普突然变成了一个不同的人。

sentences.en: I think this is who he has been for a very, very long time, going back decades.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是几十年来一直以来的他。

sentences.en: But I do think he is getting explicit in what he is saying, both as protests are growing in the country and as his own poll numbers are sinking.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为，随着国内抗议活动的增加以及他自己的民调数字下滑，他所说的话变得越来越直白。

sentences.en: But just as patriots did in centuries past, the American people will stand in their way and we will win and win quickly and with great dignity.
sentences.zh: 但正如过去几个世纪的爱国者一样，美国人民将挡在他们面前，我们将获胜，而且会迅速获胜，并带着极大的尊严。

sentences.en: He is not explicitly using the words black and white, but he is explicitly describing one version of America versus another.
sentences.zh: 他没有明确使用“黑人”和“白人”这些词，但他明确地描述了一个版本的美国与另一个版本的对立。

sentences.en: And that, I think, is different, along with the fact that we have really not seen a president before use an Independence Day speech to be so divisive
sentences.zh: 我认为这很不同，再加上我们确实从未见过有总统在独立日演讲中如此具有分裂性，

sentences.en: and to pit Americans into the way he is here.
sentences.zh: 并像他在这里所做的那样挑拨美国人之间的关系。

sentences.en: So, Maggie, how does this speech end?
sentences.zh: 那么，玛吉，这次演讲是如何结束的？

sentences.en: Americans must never lose sight of this miraculous story.
sentences.zh: 美国人绝不能忘记这个奇迹般的故事。

sentences.en: So, the president concludes this speech by saying he wants to build...
sentences.zh: 所以，总统在演讲结尾时说他想要建立……

sentences.en: I am signing an executive order to establish the National Garden of American Heroes.
sentences.zh: 我正在签署一项行政命令，以建立美国英雄国家花园。

sentences.en: A garden of statues.
sentences.zh: 一座雕像花园。

sentences.en: A vast outdoor park that will feature the statues of the greatest Americans to ever live.
sentences.zh: 一个广阔的户外公园，将展示有史以来最伟大的美国人的雕像。

sentences.en: And in this garden, he wants to put a variety of American figures, presidents, artists, sports figures.
sentences.zh: 在这个花园里，他想放置各种各样的美国人物，包括总统、艺术家和体育界人士。

sentences.en: From this night...
sentences.zh: 从今晚开始……

sentences.en: And with that...
sentences.zh: 随之而来的是……

sentences.en: And from this magnificent place...
sentences.zh: 从这个宏伟的地方……

sentences.en: The president applauded for himself and for the crowd.
sentences.zh: 总统为自己和人群鼓掌。

sentences.en: God bless your families.
sentences.zh: 愿上帝保佑你们的家庭。

sentences.en: God bless our great military.
sentences.zh: 愿上帝保佑我们伟大的军队。

sentences.en: And God bless America.
sentences.zh: 愿上帝保佑美国。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: And there was a fireworks display over Mount Rushmore.
sentences.zh: 拉什莫尔山上空举行了烟花表演。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month?
sentences.zh: 但如果能让你免费试用《时报》一个月呢？

sentences.en: For free.
sentences.zh: 免费的。

sentences.en: Without putting in a credit card.
sentences.zh: 无需输入信用卡信息。

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间跨越付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Maggie, what most surprises me about this speech and the fact that it is supposed to be a reset of a presidential campaign is that the message seems to fly in the face of polling
sentences.zh: 玛吉，关于这次演讲，以及它被视为总统竞选活动的重启，最让我惊讶的是，其传达的信息似乎与民调结果背道而驰，

sentences.en: that shows Americans don't agree with this version of how to deal with race.
sentences.zh: 民调显示美国人并不认同这种处理种族问题的方式。

sentences.en: And I want to read a question that the Times asked voters in six swing states about these protests.
sentences.zh: 我想读一下《时报》在六个摇摆州就这些抗议活动向选民提出的一个问题。

sentences.en: And here was the question.
sentences.zh: 问题是这样的。

sentences.en: Would you rather have a candidate who says that we need to be tough on protests that go too far or whether they would rather have a candidate
sentences.zh: 你更倾向于支持一位主张对过激抗议采取强硬手段的候选人，还是更倾向于支持一位

sentences.en: who says we need to focus on the cause of those protests even when they go too far?
sentences.zh: 主张即使抗议过激也要关注其背后原因的候选人？

sentences.en: And voters told the Times in those swing states by a 40% margin that they would rather have a candidate who focuses on the cause of the protests even when they go too far.
sentences.zh: 在这些摇摆州，选民以40%的优势告诉《时报》，他们更倾向于支持那位即使抗议过激也会关注其背后原因的候选人。

sentences.en: So doesn't that suggest that the president, this speech, this message is profoundly out of sync with the electorate?
sentences.zh: 那么，这难道不说明总统、这次演讲以及这一信息与选民严重脱节吗？

sentences.en: Look, Michael, you read the polls, I read the polls.
sentences.zh: 听着，迈克尔，你读民调，我也读民调。

sentences.en: They all make clear that the president is wildly out of step with where the majority of voters are right now, where conservative voters are, where independent voters are,
sentences.zh: 它们都清楚地表明，总统与目前大多数选民的立场严重不符，无论是保守派选民、独立选民，

sentences.en: where a broad spectrum of voters are.
sentences.zh: 还是广大选民群体，都是如此。

sentences.en: This is a president who likes to do things his own way, that he has ideas that he wants to put out there regardless of how much it upsets his advisors,
sentences.zh: 这位总统喜欢按自己的方式行事，他有自己的想法，无论这些想法会让他的顾问们多么不安，他都要表达出来，

sentences.en: regardless of how scared senators are about losing their seats because his rhetoric is making things very hard for them.
sentences.zh: 也不管参议员们因为他的言论让处境变得艰难而感到多么恐惧，担心失去席位。

sentences.en: But he is not where the majority of Americans are in those polls.
sentences.zh: 但在那些民调中，他并不代表大多数美国人的立场。

sentences.en: So Maggie, what is the thinking here?
sentences.zh: 那么玛吉，这里的考量是什么？

sentences.en: If the president's re-election campaign has seen those polls that you and I have all seen, like, do they see something that we're not seeing?
sentences.zh: 如果总统的连任竞选团队已经看到了你我都看到的那些民调，他们是否看到了我们没看到的东西？

sentences.en: Do they have a theory that extends beyond these poll numbers?
sentences.zh: 他们是否有一套超越这些民调数字的理论？

sentences.en: Many of the people in the president's campaign believe the direction that the polls are taking, even if they argue with some of the margins.
sentences.zh: 总统竞选团队中的许多人相信民调所呈现的趋势，即使他们对其中的一些差距有异议。

sentences.en: Some of the people around the president share with him a belief or theory or whatever you want to call it that people are not being honest with the pollsters
sentences.zh: 总统身边的一些人与他有着共同的信念或理论，或者随你怎么称呼它，即人们在面对民调人员时并不诚实，

sentences.en: when they talk about how much support they have for these protests and that the numbers will come around in President Trump's favor when we get to the fall.
sentences.zh: 当他们谈论对这些抗议活动的支持程度时，他们认为到了秋天，数字会转向有利于特朗普总统的方向。

sentences.en: And help me understand that.
sentences.zh: 帮我理解一下这一点。

sentences.en: When they say that they don't think the polls reflect the real support for this movement, what do they mean?
sentences.zh: 当他们说不认为民调反映了对这场运动的真实支持时，他们是什么意思？

sentences.en: They think that people are inclined to lie to pollsters on matters of race.
sentences.zh: 他们认为人们在种族问题上倾向于对民调人员撒谎。

sentences.en: Now, there have been campaigns where that has happened.
sentences.zh: 确实，在过去的竞选中曾发生过这种情况。

sentences.en: The margins that we're talking about are so large that it would be really hard to fathom that.
sentences.zh: 但我们现在谈论的差距如此之大，实在让人难以置信。

sentences.en: But that is the bet that some of his advisors are making.
sentences.zh: 但这正是他的一些顾问所押注的。

sentences.en: Now, are they making that on science?
sentences.zh: 那么，他们是基于科学做出这种判断吗？

sentences.en: Not necessarily.
sentences.zh: 不一定。

sentences.en: Are they making that on political research?
sentences.zh: 他们是基于政治研究吗？

sentences.en: Only on the margins.
sentences.zh: 仅在边缘地带。

sentences.en: For the most part, this is wish casting that the president is not doing himself the damage he seems to be doing.
sentences.zh: 在很大程度上，这只是一种一厢情愿的想法，认为总统并没有对自己造成他看起来正在造成的损害。

sentences.en: Maggie, campaigns tend to be defined by debates in their ranks about what is the right approach to a moment.
sentences.zh: 玛吉，竞选活动往往由其内部关于如何应对当前局势的辩论所定义。

sentences.en: So I have to imagine that inside the Trump campaign, there is a debate about whether this is the right approach to this moment.
sentences.zh: 所以我不得不认为，在特朗普竞选团队内部，对于这是否是应对当前局势的正确方法存在着辩论。

sentences.en: Is that your sense?
sentences.zh: 你是这种感觉吗？

sentences.en: No, Michael, I don't think there's much of a debate going on.
sentences.zh: 不，迈克尔，我认为并没有发生多少辩论。

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不呢？

sentences.en: Because there's the way the president wants to campaign and they try to shape it around that.
sentences.zh: 因为总统有他自己想要的竞选方式，而他们只是试图围绕这一点来塑造它。

sentences.en: This is what Donald J.
sentences.zh: 这就是唐纳德·J·

sentences.en: Trump thinks his campaign message should be.
sentences.zh: 特朗普认为他的竞选信息应该是什么样的。

sentences.en: Now, there are areas where his advisors have gotten him to stick to that script that was written out and say things that they considered to be less potentially divisive.
sentences.zh: 当然，在某些领域，他的顾问们确实让他坚持了预先写好的讲稿，并说出了一些他们认为潜在分裂性较小的话。

sentences.en: So for instance, he spoke broadly about culture in history, but he did not explicitly give a defense of Confederate statues, which really turns off
sentences.zh: 例如，他广泛地谈论了文化和历史，但他没有明确地为邦联雕像进行辩护，这确实会让

sentences.en: suburban voters, in particular suburban women.
sentences.zh: 郊区选民，特别是郊区女性感到反感。

sentences.en: And his advisors were very pleased with that, that he stuck to the script and didn't say Confederate.
sentences.zh: 他的顾问们对此非常满意，因为他坚持了讲稿，没有提到“邦联”这个词。

sentences.en: And then on Monday morning, he tweets support of the Confederate flag being aired at NASCAR events.
sentences.zh: 然后周一早上，他在推特上表达了对在纳斯卡赛事中展示邦联旗帜的支持。

sentences.en: So it undoes a lot of what had taken place before.
sentences.zh: 所以这抵消了之前所做的大部分努力。

sentences.en: Maggie, when you talk to people in the Trump campaign and you present them with what seems like a pretty significant dilemma here, a president with a message and a national mood
sentences.zh: 玛吉，当你与特朗普竞选团队的人交谈，并向他们提出这个看似相当重大的困境时，即一位总统的信息与全国情绪

sentences.en: that seems very out of sync with it, what do they say?
sentences.zh: 似乎非常不合拍，他们怎么说？

sentences.en: There's no evidence that this message is going to help the president win again.
sentences.zh: 没有证据表明这一信息会帮助总统再次获胜。

sentences.en: There is no evidence that this is a successful approach to the voters he needs in order to win.
sentences.zh: 没有证据表明这对赢得他所需的选民来说是一种成功的方法。

sentences.en: But advisors are pretty candid that he thinks this is how he won last time and he is convinced he can do it again.
sentences.zh: 但顾问们相当坦率地表示，他认为这就是他上次获胜的方式，并且他确信自己可以再次做到。

sentences.en: Right, so what you're saying is that the president is assuming that the country is more or less exactly where it was in 2016 and that this will all work out the same way
sentences.zh: 对，所以你的意思是，总统假设国家或多或少还处于2016年的状态，这一切都会以同样的方式奏效，

sentences.en: and yield the same result, an Electoral College victory based on white voters supporting him.
sentences.zh: 并产生同样的结果，即依靠支持他的白人选民赢得选举人团胜利。

sentences.en: Correct, the president is of the opinion.
sentences.zh: 没错，总统就是这么认为的。

sentences.en: And again, this is not his campaign.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这并不是他的竞选团队的普遍看法。

sentences.en: There are people in the campaign who understand this is not the same electorate.
sentences.zh: 竞选团队中有人明白现在的选民群体已经不同了。

sentences.en: But the president has convinced himself that nothing has changed, that he can turn Joe Biden into Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 但总统已经说服自己，什么都没有改变，他可以把乔·拜登变成希拉里·克林顿。

sentences.en: And so far, there is no reason to believe that either of those things is true.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，没有任何理由相信这两者中的任何一个是真的。

sentences.en: So, Maggie, at this point, is this the message that you expect the Trump campaign to be using between now and November?
sentences.zh: 那么玛吉，在这一点上，你预计特朗普竞选团队在从现在到11月之间会使用这种信息吗？

sentences.en: A message of the left being the enemy and white America needing to be afraid of this movement seeking racial equality.
sentences.zh: 一种将左派视为敌人，并让白人美国人需要对这场寻求种族平等的运动感到恐惧的信息。

sentences.en: The campaign itself, I think, would like to be delivering a less blunt instrument version of what the president is saying.
sentences.zh: 我认为竞选团队本身更愿意传达一种不那么生硬的总统言论版本。

sentences.en: But because the president is able to speak only the way he's comfortable, he will not change.
sentences.zh: 但因为总统只能以他感到舒服的方式说话，他不会改变。

sentences.en: And so, yes, I think this is what you will see for the next few months.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我认为在接下来的几个月里，你将会看到这种情况。

sentences.en: Thank you, Maggie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，玛吉。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: A Times analysis found that Black and Latino Americans have been three times as likely to become infected with the coronavirus as white Americans
sentences.zh: 《时报》的一项分析发现，黑人和拉丁裔美国人感染新冠病毒的可能性是白人美国人的三倍，

sentences.en: and have been nearly twice as likely to die from it.
sentences.zh: 死于该病毒的可能性几乎是白人的两倍。

sentences.en: The analysis was based on 640,000 infections across nearly 1,000 counties, making it the most far-reaching study yet of the pandemic's racial disparities.
sentences.zh: 该分析基于近1000个县的64万例感染病例，使其成为迄今为止关于疫情种族差异最广泛的研究。

sentences.en: In explaining the higher infection rate, experts said that Black and Latino people are more likely to have frontline jobs, rely on public transportation,
sentences.zh: 在解释较高的感染率时，专家表示，黑人和拉丁裔人更有可能从事一线工作，依赖公共交通，

sentences.en: or live in multi-generational homes, raising the risk of exposure.
sentences.zh: 或居住在多代同堂的家庭中，这增加了暴露的风险。

sentences.en: And the Supreme Court unanimously ruled that states can require members of the Electoral College to vote for the presidential candidate that they had promised to support.
sentences.zh: 最高法院一致裁定，各州可以要求选举人团成员投票给他们承诺支持的总统候选人。

sentences.en: 32 states and the District of Columbia have laws requiring electors to abide by the pledges that they take on Election Day.
sentences.zh: 32个州和哥伦比亚特区有法律要求选举人遵守他们在选举日所做的承诺。

sentences.en: But a lower court in Colorado had ruled that they may disregard those pledges when they actually cast ballots a few weeks later.
sentences.zh: 但科罗拉多州的一家下级法院曾裁定，他们在几周后实际投票时可以无视这些承诺。

sentences.en: The Supreme Court's decision curbs the independence of electors and limits a potential source of uncertainty in the upcoming presidential election.
sentences.zh: 最高法院的裁决限制了选举人的独立性，并限制了即将到来的总统选举中潜在的不确定性来源。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周在《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的建议。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何地方收听《Wirecutter秀》。
